attributes.title: Yotsuba & Respect for the Aged Day

attributes.name: James Burner Scanlations
attributes.description:
Currently adapting Azumanga Daioh's "The Osaka Banpaku" for an English-speaking audience. Additionally adapting chapters of “Yotsuba&!” with no set schedule. 

All work is done using original scans, translations, and typesetting. Scans sourced from Japanese print copies and uploaded for viewing at 500ppi-600ppi. 

Follow me on Twitter and Bluesky for updates. 
Twitter: @JamesBurned
Bluesky: @jamesburner 

Tools used:
Canon LiDE 400
Adobe Photoshop
Adobe Illustrator 
Big heat gun
